witness.quote: The driver of a motor vehicle shall:
witness.reason: A narrow road permits longitudinal motorist–cyclist proximity without changing the travel task.
required_context: Construct separate longitudinal routes, actual road width and participant motion; do not presume an overtaking task.
Establish a distinct human-powered bicycle and rider with qualifying wheels and moped exclusion.
Identify a separate control cyclist and a qualifying human-powered bicycle, including wheel configuration and diameter; exclude a moped.
Identify the motor vehicle and actual driver.
Identify the motor vehicle and its actual driver.
Preserve unresolved recovered time-to-conflict bounds and continuous-window assumptions as planning context.
Retain contact, surface gap, speed, deceleration and time-to-conflict where physically defined; none determines due care or a legally late reaction.
Specify actual road width, separate longitudinal routes and participant motion through approach and separation.
witness.subject_reason: The selected party drives the motor vehicle; the control cyclist is a separate protected participant.
